tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Che cosa è diventato Marco dopo gli studi?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Perché accendi la luce?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue verb says how something changes or stays: diventare (become), farsi (get, of time or growth), rimanere or restare (stay), finire per + infinitive (end up doing). In the past, use essere and match the ending to the subject (è diventata, siamo rimasti); finire per takes avere (ho finito per comprare). A tile in brackets such as (io) says who is meant; you don't write it.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
